svg.title: Multi-issuer revocation across AI agent receiver domains
svg.desc: Independent authority and evidence issuers publish scoped status through push and periodic pull. Each receiver domain has a local trust service, an agent group, a protected policy decision and enforcement point, and a controlled effect record retained until closure. Peer proposals still require local approval. Source: Dr. Carsten Stöcker / Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0.
